exposure: spontaneous dissection of the left anterior descending artery
cohort: The study cohort included 3 pregnant women who underwent urgent cardiac surgery for cardiovascular complications between 2009 and 2016.
finding: Prompt diagnosis and surgical intervention for cardiovascular complications during pregnancy are crucial for optimizing maternal and fetal outcomes.
mod_finding: One patient underwent concomitant cesarean section prior to cardiac surgery, while two patients underwent cesarean sections 2-3 months after cardiac surgery without complications.
